title: Subir de nivel en el selector
description: The picker's Ánimas column opens with Subir de nivel: each shared ánima that levels (Papagato and Dadista, LEVELLED in src/levels.ts) with its level, its EXP and a gold «Subir a Nv N» that grows it for real, as a won fight would, with its note (docs/dev-tools.md).

steps.caption: Subir de nivel, first in the Ánimas column: Papagato and Dadista at level 1, each with its gold button
Dadista reaches level 2 for real: its note, and the button now offers level 3
Dadista at its top level (the button greys out) and Papagato at level 2, with what it learns
